notes: Car lock fix: the email signal behind the cloud car lock could stop silently — if the mail settings were finished after a lock request was already waiting, the request was never sent. The cycle now heals itself: a waiting request is picked up on its own within about a minute once the settings are complete, failed sends are retried every ~3 minutes (max 10) as before, and the app now records the last send error so a stuck lock is diagnosable. Plus everything in 3.7.6 and earlier.
